translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content.text: A on̈ anima cajan on̈ d'a sat lum tic, lajan val cab'an syail icha junoc soldado ma icha junoc checab' yaji.
A junoc checab', snib'ej elan̈chamel sq'uic'b'i. A junoc munlajvum, snib'ej elan̈chamel scha stojol.
Icha chi' vaj yed' in yaelal tic, ujal svab' syail. Junjun ac'val ayn̈ejoch in cusc'olal.
Ayic tzin ec' jichan, te najat yec' ac'val svab'i. Tzin tzactzaj vec' b'alb'onoc, max sacb'ilaj. Svalan icha tic: ¿Janic' ol in q'ue vaan? xin chi.
Majnaquel in nivanil tic yuj noc' a'ay. Taquin̈ quechinac sat, slaj q'ue tzililjoc tz'elxi spojoval.
A in q'uinal elan̈chamel tz'eq'ui, icha yec' sjul-lab' eb' ch'alvum sjulec' d'a scal sch'al. Van sc'och in q'uinal tic d'a slajvub', man̈xa tas ayoch yipoc in c'ool.
Ach in Diosal, nacoti, a jab' in q'uinal tic, lajan icha yic squic'an juneloc quic'. Man̈xa b'aq'uin̈ tzalajc'olal ol in ajoc.
A eb' anima tzin ilan ticnaic, man̈xo ol in yil-laj eb'. Ol in sateloc, man̈xo ol in ilpaxlaj.
Icha yec' numumoc asun satxicanemi, icha chi' tz'aj satxiem junoc anima ayic sb'at mucchajcan d'a campusante. Man̈xa b'aq'uin̈ ol jaxoc, man̈xa b'aq'uin̈ ol yiloch eb' sc'ab'yoc.
Yuj chi' max yal vem numan, yuj in yaelal yed' in cusc'olal tic, ol valn̈ej tas svala'.
Mamin ¿tom lajan in icha noc' nivan noc' d'a yol a' mar tzila', yuj chi' ayn̈ejoch a sat d'ayin?
Ayic tzin naani, tecan vach' ol in vay jab'oc d'a in ch'at, tope tz'och vaan jab'oc in yaelal tic yic tzin vay jab'oc, xin chi.
Axo juntzan̈ vayich xivub'tac tzac' vila', tzin a te xib'tani.
Más vach' tzin a b'inchamoc, más vach' tzin cham d'a yichan̈ to pitzan in.
Maxtzac techaj vuj svab'i, nab'axon̈ej pitzan in. Man̈xo in ixtej. A in q'uinal tic lajan icha yic squic'an juneloc quic'.
¿Tas quelc'och a on̈ anima on̈ tic, yuj chi' tzon̈ ic'chaan̈? ¿Tas yuj tzach och ilc'olal cuuj?
¿Tas yuj ayn̈ejoch a chum d'ayon̈ d'a junjun c'u, tzon̈ ac'ann̈ej proval?
¿Tas yuj max iq'uel jab'oc a sat d'ayin, yic syal in b'uc'anem jab'oc yal in ti'?
Ach Dios, Yilumal anima aji. Tato tz'och in mul, ¿tom tzab' syail yuuj? ¿Tas yuj a d'ayin tzac'och ijan a jul-lab'? ¿Tom al vajoch d'ayach icha junoc icatz?
¿Tom maxtzac ac' nivanc'olal in mul? ¿Tom maxtzac ac' nivanc'olal tastac chucal ix in c'ulej? Toxo val tzin b'atcan d'a yol luum. Ol in a sayeq'ui, man̈xo ol in chax uuj, xchi vin̈aj Job chi'.
